sections_target.text: Stator
Keep the generator stator clean all the time and there will be no major maintenance work
Use a vacuum cleaner and smooth brushes for cleaning or even better if availiable dry air, not exceeding 3 bars of air pressure
If the CO2-fire fighting system has been operated the generator shall be checked and cleaning of all parts must be performed

sections_target.text: Rotor
Keep the generator rotor clean all the time there will be no major maintenance work
Use vacuum cleaner and smooth brushes for cleaning
The slip rings should be inspected monthly to check their wear and proper operation.
Worn brushes should be changed when wear is approximately fifty percent of the original length (use for rotor earth fault)
Measure the insulation resistance and polarization index after the unit is out of network
Check the operation of the generator standstill heating.
Check the operation of the generator brake limits switch's
Check the operation of dehumidifier
Check the RTD s of hot air and cold air
Clean the neutral point of generator
Check the position of the rotor locking bolt
Clean the over hang of the stator winding by vaccum cleaner and smooth brushes
Clean the generator over hang by use alcohol
Keep the generator section of the bulb always absolutely clean

uncertain_terms.note: The source document is largely in English already (mixed Arabic headings and English body); the English source text is kept verbatim and only the Arabic parts were translated.
Header table reads 'القوة المحطة' / 'التقنية الإجراء' – garbled; rendered as 'Power Station' / 'Technical Procedure' by inference from the MPIS header pattern.
Source 'on yearly bases' kept verbatim; 'bases' is presumably a typo for 'basis'.
Generator type 'إس في 581/88-170' rendered as 'SV 581/88-170' ('إس في' = S V); not verified against the nameplate.
Suspect value: rated speed given as '68318 rpm' – implausible for a hydro generator of this size (possibly 68.3 rpm or a garbled value); kept verbatim.
'يتم تطبيق قاطع المولد' rendered as 'The generator circuit breaker is closed.'; 'يتم تطبيق' is ambiguous here.
'قم بتوصيل المفتاح الأرضي للمولد CB' rendered as 'Connect the generator earthing switch.'; the trailing 'CB' in the source is unclear.

'افصل الحامل الذي لا يزال يسخن المولد' is garbled; rendered as 'Switch off the generator standstill heating.' by inference (the same item appears as 'التحقق من تشغيل الوقوف ساكنا تسخين المولد' in the work list).
